description: This file defines the UserService interface, which extends a generic service interface and includes methods for user management such as retrieving users by username, listing users, saving/updating users, and listing users by their associated store.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Java interface defining user-related operations within the sales manager system, extending a generic entity service.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User object based on the provided username.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Returns a list of all users.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates a new or updates an existing User object.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists users associated with a specific store.
